lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Mozambique in 2018. Geographic data representing food insecurity phases were compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML) for February, June, and December projections, with classifications indicating severity of acute food insecurity by administrative unit.
